For a new Indian clothing store, I’d shortlist:

Option	Price	Features	Availability
Razorpay	2% + GST; ₹0 setup/AMC	UPI, cards, wallets, net banking, payment links, refunds, strong integrations	Pan-India 
Razorpay
+1

Cashfree	Promotional 0% on first ₹20L for eligible new merchants; otherwise ~1.95%+	UPI, cards, 180+ methods, fast checkout, next-day settlement	Pan-India 
Cashfree
+1

PayU	2% + GST domestic cards/net banking; higher for some methods	UPI, cards, wallets, BNPL, EMI, net banking	Pan-India 
PayU

My pick: Cashfree if you're eligible for its current offer; otherwise Razorpay for the easiest all-round setup.

UPI-only: Cheapest payment acceptance can be attractive, but a gateway gives you cards, EMI, payment links, refunds and better checkout/reconciliation. Note that zero UPI MDR doesn't necessarily mean zero gateway/platform fees. 
Razorpay
